newsitem.title: UK: UK trade group outline food transport code.
newsitem.headline: UK trade group outline food transport code.

text.p: A code of practice on the transport of bulk food-grade commodities was outlined by the United Kingdom Agricultural Supply Trade Association (UKASTA) in London on Friday.
UKASTA director general Jim Reed said in a statement that he was optimistic the code would be widely adopted and supported by the grain and feed trade industries from August.
It specifically identifies commodities which should never be carried in vehicles involved in the haulage of food-grade commodities, UKASTA said.
UKASTA represents animal feed manufacturers and agricultural merchants.
